from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1'
items=[('20230501','https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1453'),('20230731','https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1662')]
receipts=[]
for date,url in items:
    rec={'date':date,'url':url,'attempts':[]}
    for attempt in range(1,3):
        r=None;item={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
        try:
            r=requests.get(url,timeout=(15,35),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
            item['http_status']=r.status_code;r.raise_for_status()
            p=out/('sources/'+date+'_Treasury借款预估原文.html');p.write_bytes(r.content)
            item['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';rec['attempts'].append(item)
            rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',path=str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest())
            soup=BeautifulSoup(r.content,'html.parser');main=soup.find('article') or soup.find('main') or soup
            print('原文：',date,'；页面标题：',soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True))
            print('图片：',[(x.get('alt'),x.get('src')) for x in main.find_all('img')])
            print('候选定义/表链接：',[(a.get_text(' ',strip=True),a.get('href')) for a in main.find_all('a') if any(k in (a.get_text(' ',strip=True)+' '+str(a.get('href'))).lower() for k in ['sources and uses','borrowing','quarter','cash','soma'])][-14:])
            body=main.find(class_='field--name-body') or main
            paragraphs=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in body.find_all(['p','li'])]
            paragraphs=[' '.join(x.split()) for x in paragraphs]
            print('正文：',json.dumps([x for x in paragraphs if any(k in x for k in ['Treasury expects','cash balance','SOMA','trillion','bill','[1]','[2]','[3]'])],ensure_ascii=False)[:6600])
            break
        except Exception as e:
            item.update(status='REQUEST_FAILED',error=str(e)[:800]);rec['attempts'].append(item)
            if r is not None and r.status_code in (403,429):break
    rec.setdefault('status','FAILED_AFTER_REGISTERED_ATTEMPTS');receipts.append(rec)
(out/'source_receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tls_verify':True,'receipts':receipts},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
(out/'locator_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'query':'site:home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases \"Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates\" \"2023\" (\"May 1\" OR \"July 31\")',
 'calls':1,'selected_release_urls':[u for _,u in items],
 'disclosure':'定位搜索同时显示其他年份/季度预览及数值；未改变固定日期、未下载它们、未使用股票标签，也不声称新历史独立。'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
